description: Retrieve the full text of one section of an HMRC internal manual (or another UK departmental manual), by its base_path or by manual plus section id such as EIM42750. Returns the section title, its text, its place in the manual's structure, whether it has been withdrawn, and its published_at / source_last_modified with age_days so you can tell how current HMRC's stated position is.

manual.description: Manual base_path or slug, used together with section_id.

name: hmrc_manual_section
title: Hmrc Manual Section
